name: infeara
description: Fifty-one Infeara skills — 23 expert personas, a 10-role delivery team, and a 15-person sales and marketing team — for business, technology, security, audit, legal, marketing, and document work.

interface.longDescription: Infeara packages 51 skills into one plugin. The expert library covers chief executive, financial, technology and operating officers; founder and co-founder; marketing, sales, digital marketing (Google Ads and Meta Ads) and content; a professional document writer for cover pages, pagination, letterheads and brand typography; research and development, client success, business management and legal; lead auditor, CISO auditor and compliance; and cloud, DevOps, server, network and cyber security specialists. Two full teams sit on top. A ten-role delivery team — engagement manager, solution architect, technical lead, implementation engineer, QA, deployment, documentation, security, project and account manager — runs engagements from discovery to handover. A fifteen-person revenue team — GTM strategist, product marketing, brand, content, campaigns, SEO, marketing ops, SDR, account executive, solutions consultant, sales ops, proposals and partnerships — runs demand creation and conversion against one pipeline number, with orchestration by a team lead, a sprint orchestrator and a pipeline orchestrator. The chief executive acts as the entry point: given a multi-function task it decomposes the work, delegates each workstream to the internal role that owns it, sequences the handoffs and returns a single consolidated answer with attribution. Each skill supplies playbooks, templates, quality checklists and guardrails, and hands work to the roles that own adjacent decisions. The plugin runs entirely on packaged instructions: no network calls, no data collection, nothing stored outside the conversation. It does not execute code, sign contracts, file with a regulator, or replace qualified legal, financial or audit professionals; outputs are working drafts for a human to review.
capabilities: Agentic CEO that decomposes tasks and delegates to internal teams
Expert guidance across 23 business and technology domains
Ten-role delivery team with defined handoffs and gates
Fifteen-person sales and marketing team with funnel maths
Pipeline reviews, forecasting and SLA tracking
Security review and threat modelling for builds
Brand-compliant documents with cover pages and pagination
